Research notes, BestBet.

Created because the Meet Manager article names it among supported timers.

Everything established comes from one page of Hy-Tek's Meet Manager 8 guide
(hytek.active.com/user_guides_html/swmm8/bestbet.htm, read September 2026), and it is
mostly a comparison rather than a description: the BestBet console interfaces with Meet
Manager the same way a Colorado Time Systems 4 does, with one difference, that the cable
must be a null modem rather than a straight serial cable. Hy-Tek also places it in the
group of consoles that cannot take an event download from the program.

That the vendor explains a console by reference to the CTS 4 is itself informative about
where the BestBet sits: it behaves like an older serial console rather than a networked
one.

Spelling. Hy-Tek writes BestBet in the topic title and BestBET in the interface matrix. A
search of the held periodicals for "Best Bet" returns only ordinary English, so the company
is absent from the swimming press held here, or unfindable in it.

Still to research: who makes it, where and when; what the console is; whether BestBet is a
brand or a company; and whether any facility this wiki covers uses one.

This article is a stub. BestBet is a swimming timing console that
[Hy-Tek Meet Manager](../software/hy-tek-meet-manager.md) supports, and which Hy-Tek
documents chiefly by saying it behaves like a Colorado Time Systems 4 except that its cable
must be a null modem.

Nothing else about the product or its maker is established from the sources available here;
see the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
